about.en: 龙虾 ("lobster", traded on some venues as LONGXIA) is a Chinese-language community memecoin on BNB Smart Chain. It was launched through the Four.meme launchpad on 27 February 2026 as a BEP-20 token at 0xECcbb861c0dda7eFd964010085488B69317E4444 with a 1,000,000,000 supply, and has no protocol or issuer behind it.
